request.subject: UNIT:GOBLIN:FIGHTER

layers.text: Recolour only his skin (head, ears, arms, hands, belly, legs and feet): a bright lime green, colour #86c232, with lighter #acdc55 on the face, nose and belly and #5a9424 as shading; no dark teal and no dark green shadows on the skin. Keep everything else exactly the same: the big eyes, open mouth, sand leather cap, straps, loincloth, belt, shoulder plates, tin cleaver with yellow paint, pose, thick black outline and art style, on a transparent background.
